item.title: A 6.1 earthquake jolts southern Panama after Friday’s destructive tremors
item.description: USGS recorded a magnitude 6.8 earthquake, central Mid-Atlantic Ridge. A tsunami warning was associated with this event. [Confirmado] Fuentes: USGS (earthquakes), Associated Press, Reuters

item.title: 2 American economists win Nobel for work on managing economic shocks
item.description: Prices can get sticky. That helps explain why recessions hurt so much — and what policymakers can do about them. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, Financial Times, NPR

item.title: La región de huracanes del Pacífico establece un récord de tormentas grandes y duraderas gracias a El Niño
item.description: El Niño ha seguido fortaleciéndose, con varias medidas clave ahora en territorio récord. Simon King explora cómo se compara con eventos anteriores. [Confirmado] Fuentes: Associated Press, BBC News, The Guardian

item.title: Threat of AI share crash puts world financial stability at risk, says IMF
item.description: The recalled bicycles’ front lock nut can loosen during use, causing the front wheel to dislodge or loosen over time, posing a crash hazard. [Confirmado] Fuentes: U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission, The Guardian

item.title: Pennsylvania coroner reports measles death, toll rises to six
item.description: Latest fatality is unvaccinated woman, 39, with ‘underlying conditions’ but CDC still lists only two deaths nationwide A sixth death has been announced in Pennsylvania ’s measles outbreak, as new figures show cases in the state have risen… [Confirmado] Fuentes: Reuters, The Guardian, The Washington Post

item.title: Storm Rachel batters Southern California, brings flooding to Las Vegas
item.description: Large waves from the post-tropical cyclone battered homes in Long Beach, and brought flooding to parts of Las Vegas near the famed Strip. [Confirmado] Fuentes: BBC News, The Guardian, The Washington Post
